name: @flashylabs/stack.json
description: web4/1 — the machine-readable index of the Web 4 / agentic-internet stack. One document, a schema, a dependency-free checker and the tests that keep them agreeing.

scripts.lint: node --check vendor-stack.mjs && node --check vendor-aao-check.mjs && node --check test/stack.test.mjs && node --check test/charter-conformance.test.mjs && node --check test/mesh-references.test.mjs && node -e "for (const f of ['stack.json','stack.schema.json','package.json','flashyos.roles.json','directory.fragment.json']) JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'))"
